summary: Beta-readiness sweep for cdxi | OS — both backend and frontend tested end-to-end against the external preview URL. Backend pytest: 25/25 PASS including the newly added brute-force lockout (5 fails on a random non-existent email -> 6th returns 429 with 'Try again in ~X minute(s)') and a live GPT-5.2 round-trip via /api/copilot/chat. Frontend: login (parker@cdxi.au / 220191) succeeds + redirects to /, all 7 nav routes (/, /clients, /projects, /billing, /contracts, /agents, /settings) load with zero page errors and zero console errors. Sidebar shows OPERATE/MONEY/INTELLIGENCE/SYSTEM section labels (lowercase in DOM, rendered uppercase via CSS). Atlas dock (data-testid=open-copilot) opens, message sent, real GPT-5.2 reply rendered ('Our three brands are cdxi, fourtee2, and fleshsesh.'). Cmd+K palette (data-testid=open-palette) opens, typed search shows results, ESC closes it. Theme toggle flips document.documentElement[data-theme] dark<->light and updates localStorage('theme') + body bg color (rgb(10,11,20) <-> rgb(245,246,250)); layout intact. Sidebar collapse chevron shrinks aside from 240px -> 68px and back. NewClientDialog created a client which immediately appeared (Total Clients 0 -> 1). Sign-out icon in sidebar footer logs out and returns to /login.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout is in-memory only — process restart resets counters (acceptable trade-off, but document it).
Field is `event_name` (not `action`); ensure any future public docs/UI match.
Hard 400 if completed=true is sent before payment_status='paid'; surface this rule in API docs/UI.

issues: After switching to light mode the sidebar section labels (OPERATE/MONEY/INTELLIGENCE/SYSTEM) and inactive nav items appear very low-contrast against the near-white background. Consider darkening label color tokens for the light variant.

Active nav item uses a faint indigo background tint (bg-indigo-500/10). Spec language ('indigo left accent') suggests an explicit left bar — if intended, add a `border-l-2 border-indigo-500` (or ::before bar) for stronger visual affordance.

action_items: (Optional polish) Improve sidebar light-mode contrast for section labels and inactive nav items.
(Optional polish) Add an explicit indigo left accent bar on the active sidebar item to match spec wording.
(Optional doc) Note that brute-force lockout state resets on backend restart.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains ~2700 lines — recommend splitting into routers/ modules (auth, copilot, clients, projects, milestones, contracts, invoices, tenants, agents, seed).
Brute-force lockout is in-memory dict; for multi-replica deployments move to Redis/Mongo TTL collection.
/api/copilot/chat now has 45s timeout — good. No per-user rate limit; consider one to cap LLM spend.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True still present; harmless here (Bearer-token auth, no cookies) but should be tightened before any cookie-based session usage.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (all 14 scenarios verified); 2 minor design polish items

test_credentials: parker@cdxi.au / 220191 (admin, tenant_id=default) — verified working. Brute-force test uses random lockout-test-<uuid>@example.com so parker is never locked.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates and tears down a TEST_-prefixed client+project chain. Frontend UI test created one 'UI Test Client <ts>' that remains in the default tenant clients list (visible to user; safe to delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_cdxi_os_backend.py is the single source of truth for backend regression — now includes brute-force lockout case. Lockout is in-memory, so if you accidentally trigger it on parker run `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. For UI: data-testid hooks confirmed working: open-copilot, open-palette, tenant-switcher-btn. Other useful selectors: button[title='Sign out'] (sidebar footer logout), button[title='Collapse sidebar']/'Expand sidebar', button[title*='mode'] (theme toggle). Theme persistence uses document.documentElement[data-theme] + localStorage('theme'). Frontend stores JWT in localStorage as `access_token`.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features green. Two design polish items are subjective and not blockers for beta launch.
